assumptions.statement: Viability is exact finite controlled invariance of K={0} for a declared three-step disturbance family.
Four excess-load variables remain after a passive plant has absorbed its declared disturbance envelope.
At m=1, each candidate pair has fixed control budget two.

assumptions.role: Defines typed upward and downward adjacent-level maps.
assumptions.statement: At m=2, an upper regulator may transfer one budget unit between local units while preserving one unit for each.

assumptions.role: Makes hierarchy-depth selection explicit and penalized.
assumptions.statement: Failure costs twenty units and model complexity is (0,3,7,11) for depths zero through three.

comparators: m=2 local controls plus upper resource regulator

concept.invariant: Each earned level must have a boundary, essential variables, held-out viability advantage, upward sufficient statistic, downward constraint/control map, and complexity-paid depth.

equations: m=2: b in {(2,2),(3,1),(1,3)} from upward group demands

free_choices.choice: Use four micro-variables and enumerate all pair partitions.
free_choices.sensitivity_test: Test every component relabeling and a twofold resolution refinement.
free_choices.why_not_forced: This is the smallest nontrivial exact partition tournament.

free_choices.choice: Use a one-unit upper-level budget transfer.
free_choices.sensitivity_test: Remove the downward map, retain the upward sums, and require the RG-only null to lose viability.
free_choices.why_not_forced: It plants a minimal genuine downward control advantage.

free_choices.choice: Use penalty multipliers one, three, and five.
free_choices.sensitivity_test: Require the planted depth to remain selected across all three.
free_choices.why_not_forced: No unique MDL coding convention is claimed.

result.claim: A finite controlled-invariance tournament can recover planted depths zero, one, and two while rejecting passive, arbitrary-partition, redundant-depth, memorization, RG-only, and clock-copy nulls. This conditionally realizes objective depth discovery, but does not make Beer functions into physical levels or establish the prior System-4/self-authoring claim.
result.grade: EXACT FINITE CONDITIONAL CONSTRUCTION / DEPTH DISCOVERY REALIZED / FINALITY-VSM INFERENCE NOT ESTABLISHED
result.remaining_uncertainty: No DU dynamics, physical boundary, adaptive System 4, observer, post, clock, scale, or cosmological map has been discovered.

stop_conditions: Do not infer literal Beer S1-S5 structure from a viability hierarchy.

Do not infer purpose, agency, consciousness, or self-authorship.
Do not connect the construction to Lambda, posts, or clocks without typed maps.
